claim: ...and produced 52 internal projects with the majority of production in Victoria.

quotes: over the same period the ABC invested over $80 million in 52 internal productions based in Victoria, delivering a further 507 hours
over the same period the ABC spent $80 million on 52 internal projects
detail.critic_finding: The source says the 52 internal productions were "based in Victoria," not that the "majority of production" took place there. That "majority of production" framing applies to the 75 external commissions, not the internal projects.
detail.report_says: 52 internal shows had most of their work done in Victoria
detail.source_says: 52 internal shows were based in Victoria, not just majority-produced there
detail.so_what: The report says 52 internal shows had most of their work done in Victoria. The source only says 52 internal shows were based in Victoria, not just majority-produced there.
